calendar.label: Week calendar
phase.morning.hint: Fresh mail: cables from the Centre, clippings, agent reports.
phase.day.hint: Analysis and planning: SDR routes, meetings, payments.
phase.night.hint: What to report to the Centre? The week ends after the report.
report.truth.hint: Honest about results and failures. Failures will displease the Centre.
report.embellished.hint: The Centre's trust grows now, but the lie may surface at the next audit.
report.silence.hint: No unnecessary details. Hidden failures may surface at the audit.
analyst.title: Rezidentura analyst's summary
event.lie_uncovered: The Centre caught the rezidentura lying (report of week {week})
ending.persona_non_grata.title: Persona non grata
ending.persona_non_grata.text: Week {week}. The FBI photographed the handover. A State Department note, 48 hours to pack. The rezidentura is beheaded.
ending.recalled.title: Recalled to Moscow
ending.recalled.text: Week {week}. The Centre has lost patience. The cable is short: hand over your files and take the first Aeroflot flight home.
ending.mole_arrested.title: The mole is arrested
ending.mole_arrested.text: Week {week}. The circle of suspects at Langley has narrowed to one name. The source is under arrest.
ending.campaign_complete.title: End of the vertical slice
ending.campaign_complete.text: Week {week}. The first source is recruited: the Act I objective is complete. To be continued in Act II.
inbox.name: Inbox
inbox.hint: Cables, clippings, memos and intercepts from this and past weeks
inbox.pick: Pick a document on the left.
inbox.allRead: All read. New mail arrives in the morning.
finance.threshold: CTR reporting threshold (Form 4789): $10,000 in cash per day.
counterintel.empty: The card index is empty. The List arrives in Act III.
sdr.plan.title: This week's outings
sdr.plan.hint: Lay out a surveillance detection route: three everyday stops in different districts, then the target. Click stops on the map or in the list.
sdr.plan.limit: No more than {n} outings can be planned per week.
sdr.warn.fewDistricts: Stops in only {districts} district(s): on familiar ground the SOG team swaps cars and a repeat may go unseen.
sdr.warn.outsideZone: "{name}" is beyond 25 miles: travelling without State Department clearance will alert the watchers.
sdr.evening.title: Evening: outings
sdr.evening.none: No outings tonight. Routes are planned during the day.
sdr.idle: Routes are planned by day and driven in the evening.
sdr.run.rule: Once is coincidence, twice is enemy action. Spot a repeat and fall back on your cover story.
sdr.run.abort: Fall back on the cover story
sdr.result.abortedText: The resident drove back to the embassy like any shopper. A day lost, but the outing can be repeated next week.
sdr.verdict.title: Verdict: was there a tail?
sdr.verdict.hint: Comparison notebook: everything you saw at the three stops. Click to circle anything suspicious; these are your notes. Look for what appeared twice: a car, clothing, a person.
sdr.verdict.tail: Tail: fall back on the cover story
service.title: Service folder
saves.autosave: The game saves after every action. Last autosave:
saves.ironmanOn: Iron Curtain mode: autosave only, no do-overs. Last autosave:
saves.checkpoints: Checkpoints (start of every month and act)
saves.ironmanNoCheckpoints: There are no checkpoints in Iron Curtain mode.
saves.ironman: Iron Curtain: a single save only
saves.ironmanHint: For veterans: decisions cannot be replayed. The normal mode does not require this.
settings.textScaleHint: Enlarges documents, panels and labels. The desk layout stays the same.
risk.sog_heat.at100: At 100%: a State Department note and the resident's expulsion
risk.mole_hunt.at100: At 100%: Langley narrows the circle, the mole is arrested
risk.treasury.at100: At 100%: a financial audit, the Langley mole hunt speeds up twofold
risk.moscow_pressure.at100: At 100%: the resident is recalled to Moscow
